camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise CreateAbacPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --AbacPolicyName policy_test --AbacPolicyDesc test --AbacPolicyContent '{"Statement":[{"Action":"*","Effect":"Allow","Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEqualsIgnoreCase":{"dms:DbType":["redis"]}}}],"Version":"1"}' --Tid 3000
description_en: Creates a policy to manage the permissions on DMS features and data resources managed in DMS in a fine-grained manner
description_zh: 调用此API可以创建权限策略，以帮助您对DMS功能以及托管在DMS的数据资源进行细粒度的管控
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise create-abac-policy --abac-policy-name policy_test --abac-policy-desc test --abac-policy-content '{"Statement":[{"Action":"*","Effect":"Allow","Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEqualsIgnoreCase":{"dms:DbType":["redis"]}}}],"Version":"1"}' --tid 3000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAbacPolicy

parameters.help_en: The name of the policy. The name must be unique for the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 权限策略名称，租户内唯一
parameters.name: abac_policy_name

parameters.help_en: The content of the policy. Specifies whether the authorized user can access and use the resources and features defined in the policy
parameters.help_zh: 策略内容。设置被授权人员是否可以访问和使用的数据资源及相关功能
parameters.name: abac_policy_content

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
